sentences.en: My boss comes to me and says, Shannon, he said, I want you to shut everything down, put the furnaces in idle at 1500 degrees, take the gas out.
sentences.zh: 我老板跑来跟我说，香农，他说，我希望你把所有设备都停掉，在1500度时让熔炉进入待机状态，把燃气排空。

sentences.en: And he said, well, when you're done, just come to a meeting in the back dock.
sentences.zh: 他还说，好吧，弄完之后就去后卸货平台开个会。

sentences.en: And I'm like, what?
sentences.zh: 我就想，什么？

sentences.en: Are you serious?
sentences.zh: 你认真的吗？

sentences.en: And he's like, yes, please.
sentences.zh: 然后他说，对，拜托了。

sentences.en: By the time she was done, she started walking to the meeting and she could hear her co-workers yelling.
sentences.zh: 等她忙完，开始往会场走去时，她能听到同事们在呐喊。

sentences.en: And they were just told that the factory was closing and their jobs would move to a new plant in Mexico, Monterey, Mexico, and another facility in McAllen, Texas.
sentences.zh: 他们刚刚接到通知，工厂要关门了，他们的工作将转移到墨西哥的新工厂，即墨西哥蒙特雷，以及德克萨斯州麦卡伦的另一家工厂。

sentences.en: I know that this is an incredibly tough message and you guys have a lot of questions.
sentences.zh: 我知道这是一个极其艰难的消息，大家肯定有很多疑问。

sentences.en: At this time, because we've just engaged and we've just invited the steel workers to start talking,
sentences.zh: 目前，因为我们刚刚接触并邀请了钢铁工人工会开始对话，

sentences.en: I don't have any further information and I can't answer any questions.
sentences.zh: 我没有任何进一步的信息，也无法回答任何问题。

sentences.en: And some of these workers had spent their whole lives in this plant.
sentences.zh: 其中有些工人在这个工厂度过了大半辈子。

sentences.en: They were totally shocked, even though the company had been secretly planning this for years.
sentences.zh: 他们感到极其震惊，尽管公司多年来一直在秘密策划此事。

sentences.en: It's got to be a tough job to do that everywhere you go, huh?
sentences.zh: 无论走到哪儿都要面对这种艰难的工作，一定很不容易吧？

sentences.en: Oh, I mean, I made it to my car and I cried and cried and I just was thinking, what am I going to do?
sentences.zh: 哦，我是说，我一走到车里就放声大哭，满脑子都在想，我该怎么办？

sentences.en: Even though I made good money, I still work paycheck to paycheck.
sentences.zh: 尽管我收入不错，但我依然是过着月光族的生活。

sentences.en: I didn't plan on saving any money for something like this to happen, you know?
sentences.zh: 我从没想过要存钱以防这种事发生，你知道吗？

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: I would have never thought.
sentences.zh: 我做梦也没想到。

sentences.en: And this was a really tough time for her because Shannon also had a daughter who was a high school
sentences.zh: 这对她来说是一段非常艰难的时期，因为香农还有一个读高中的女儿，

sentences.en: senior who wanted to be the first in her family to go to college and Shannon wanted to try to help her pay for it.
sentences.zh: 快毕业了，她想成为家里第一个上大学的人，而香农想尽力帮她支付学费。

sentences.en: I was freaking out, like, because I don't want her future to be ruined because I lost my job and unable to pay for her to go to college.
sentences.zh: 我当时快急疯了，因为我不想毁了她的未来，只因为我失业了，供不起她上大学。

sentences.en: And she also had a son who was really financially struggling, didn't have a job, depended on her financially.
sentences.zh: 她还有一个儿子，经济状况非常窘迫，没有工作，在经济上依赖她。

sentences.en: And he had a four-year-old daughter who was disabled and they both depended on Shannon's paycheck.
sentences.zh: 他有一个四岁的残疾女儿，父女俩都靠香农的薪水过活。

sentences.en: She was the breadwinner of the house.
sentences.zh: 她是家里的顶梁柱。

sentences.en: I got to have a roof over her head and, you know, a decent place for her to live.
sentences.zh: 我得给她一个遮风避雨的地方，你知道的，一个像样点的住处。

sentences.en: You know, if it was just me, I mean, I could live on the street if I had to.
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果只是我自己的话，我是说，如果非要的话我甚至可以流落街头。

sentences.en: I don't want to, that thought of that.
sentences.zh: 我不想这样，一想到那种可能就……

sentences.en: But, you know, it can happen that quick.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，那种事发生得就是这么快。

sentences.en: I just want to be sure I understand your financial and familial obligations at this point when you hear that your employer is going to be moving all these jobs to Mexico.
sentences.zh: 我只是想确认我是否理解了你目前的财务和家庭状况，在你听说雇主准备把所有这些工作都搬到墨西哥之后。

sentences.en: You have your house, you have your car, you have a son who doesn't work, you have a daughter you're helping to support, and you have a quite sick granddaughter.
sentences.zh: 你有房子，有车，有个不工作的儿子，有个你要帮衬的女儿，还有一个病得不轻的孙女。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: As well as just yourself and everything that you need to do to take care of yourself.
sentences.zh: 还有你自己，以及照顾自己所需的一切。

sentences.en: Am I missing anything?
sentences.zh: 我漏掉什么了吗？

sentences.en: No, and my dogs.
sentences.zh: 没有了，还有我的狗。

sentences.en: The night that it happened, she drives home, she's incredibly upset, and she writes on Facebook that she wishes that someone would burn the factory in Mexico to the ground.
sentences.zh: 事情发生的当晚，她开车回家，心情极其糟糕，于是在脸书上发文，说她希望有人能把墨西哥的那家工厂烧成灰烬。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: She was so upset, and she just didn't know what to do next.
sentences.zh: 她太难过了，完全不知道接下来该怎么办。

sentences.en: She couldn't believe that it wasn't against the law.
sentences.zh: 她简直不敢相信这居然不违法。

sentences.en: How could this not be against the law to send people's jobs overseas?
sentences.zh: 把人们的工作送到海外去，怎么会不违法呢？

sentences.en: We are going to make this decision now.
sentences.zh: 我们现在要作出这个决定。

sentences.en: The Fox News decision desk has called Pennsylvania for Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 福克斯新闻决策台宣布宾夕法尼亚州归属唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: And then a few weeks later, Donald Trump wins the election.
sentences.zh: 然后几周后，唐纳德·特朗普赢得了大选。

sentences.en: Donald J.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·J·

sentences.en: Trump is the president of the United States elect.

sentences.en: He spoke to the disaffected.
sentences.zh: 他说出了失意者的心声。

sentences.en: And she suddenly becomes hopeful that he's going to save her job, and she's not the only one.
sentences.zh: 她突然燃起了希望，觉得他会拯救她的工作，而且不只有她一个人这么想。

sentences.en: A lot of the co-workers at this factory felt like he was definitely going to save their job, especially after Trump started tweeting about them.
sentences.zh: 这家工厂的许多同事都觉得他绝对会保住他们的工作，特别是特朗普开始在推特上发文谈论他们之后。

sentences.en: The president tweeted about their company.
sentences.zh: 总统在推特上提到了他们的公司。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: You know, Rexnord is firing 300 workers.
sentences.zh: 你知道，雷克诺德正在解雇300名工人。

sentences.en: No more.
sentences.zh: 够了。

sentences.en: Well, a tweet from President Donald Trump criticizes Indianapolis manufacturer Rexnord for moving a plant and jobs to Mexico.
sentences.zh: 嗯，总统唐纳德·特朗普的一条推特批评了印第安纳州的制造商雷克诺德，指责其将工厂和工作岗位搬迁至墨西哥。

sentences.en: An Indiana company's decision to move to Mexico is getting renewed attention tonight from President
sentences.zh: 印第安纳州一家公司决定搬迁至墨西哥，今晚再次受到总统

sentences.en: Trump.
sentences.zh: 特朗普的关注。

sentences.zh: 他在今晚发推称……

sentences.en: It said, Rexnord of Indiana is moving to Mexico and rather viciously firing all of its
sentences.zh: 上面写着，印第安纳州的雷克诺德公司正准备搬往墨西哥，并相当残忍地解雇了其全部

sentences.en: 300 workers.
sentences.zh: 300名工人。

sentences.zh: 这种事正在我们国家到处发生。

sentences.en: No more.
sentences.zh: 不能再这样了。

sentences.en: I thought, well, wow, he does notice us people that's down here, you know.
sentences.zh: 我想，哇，他确实注意到了我们这些生活在社会底层的人，你知道的。

sentences.en: And they spent hours debating, like, what does that mean?
sentences.zh: 他们花了几个小时争论，这到底是什么意思？

sentences.en: No more.

sentences.zh: 雷克诺德不在此列吗？

sentences.en: Or is Rexnord included in the no more?
sentences.zh: 还是说雷克诺德也被包含在这个“不能再这样”里？

sentences.en: But a lot of them really took it as a sign of hope.
sentences.zh: 但他们中的很多人真的把这当作了一个充满希望的信号。

sentences.en: He is going to save this factory.
sentences.zh: 他要拯救这家工厂了。

sentences.en: I was very hopeful.
sentences.zh: 我当时抱有很大的希望。

sentences.en: All of us were hopeful.
sentences.zh: 我们所有人都怀揣希望。

sentences.en: A lot of us there at Rexnord was thinking that he might step in and stop what was going on, you know.
sentences.zh: 雷克诺德的很多人当时都认为他可能会介入并阻止正在发生的事情，你知道的。

sentences.en: So you believed that Trump could potentially save...
sentences.zh: 所以你当时相信特朗普有可能拯救……

sentences.en: I mean, he's the president.
sentences.zh: 我是说，他可是总统。

sentences.en: Why couldn't he?
sentences.zh: 他怎么就不能呢？

sentences.en: He can do whatever he wants, right?
sentences.zh: 他想干什么就能干什么，对吧？

sentences.en: To the point, I mean, I just kind of thought, you know, because he's kind of like a cowboy.
sentences.zh: 甚至于，我是说，我当时就觉得，你知道的，因为他有点像个西部牛仔。

sentences.en: He says things probably like a lot of past presidents wouldn't say.
sentences.zh: 他说话的方式可能是很多过去的总统不会采用的。

sentences.en: So, I mean, the way he talked about American jobs and all that, I was thinking, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以，我是说，他谈论美国工作岗位以及诸如此类的方式，让我觉得，你知道，

sentences.en: this could be the opportunity where he's right that, you know, a lot of our jobs might come back from overseas and things like that.
sentences.zh: 这可能是一个契机，他说得对，我们很多工作岗位也许会从海外回流，诸如此类。

sentences.en: And a lot of people get their jobs back.
sentences.zh: 然后很多人就能重新找回工作。

sentences.en: That would be awesome.
sentences.zh: 那可太棒了。

sentences.en: You know, she voted for Obama in 2008.
sentences.zh: 你知道，她在2008年投了奥巴马的票。

sentences.en: I did vote for Obama and I do still to this day say that Obama is a good president, was a good president.
sentences.zh: 我的确投了奥巴马的票，而且直到今天我仍然认为奥巴马是个好总统，过去是个好总统。

sentences.en: And, you know, I wish he could be there again.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我希望他能再次执政。

sentences.en: She liked what he did for health care.
sentences.zh: 她很喜欢他在医疗保健方面做出的政绩。

sentences.en: And she thought about voting for Hillary because Hillary talked about the Family and Medical
sentences.zh: 她曾考虑过投票给希拉里，因为希拉里谈到了《家庭与医疗假法案》，

sentences.en: Leave Act, which is something that Shannon had used when her granddaughter got sick.
sentences.zh: 香农在孙女生病时就曾用过这个法案。

sentences.en: But at the end of the day, the job was the most important thing for Shannon.
sentences.zh: 但归根结底，工作对香农来说才是最重要的。

sentences.en: It was her entire life.
sentences.zh: 那是她的整个生活。

sentences.en: It was her identity.
sentences.zh: 那是她的身份认同。

sentences.en: The other things were, you know, they were luxuries.
sentences.zh: 其他的事情，你知道，那都是奢侈品。

sentences.en: They were a social safety net that she didn't want to have to need.
sentences.zh: 它们只是她根本不想依赖的社会安全网。

sentences.en: So she was on social media supporting Trump.
sentences.zh: 所以她在社交媒体上支持特朗普。

sentences.en: She would tweet to him.
sentences.zh: 她会给他发推特。

sentences.en: Anytime you tweet about Rex Nord, she tweeted back.
sentences.zh: 只要你发关于雷克诺德的推特，她就会回复。

sentences.en: He was all over her Facebook page.
sentences.zh: 他的身影遍布她的脸书主页。

sentences.en: She felt like he did care about people like her and spoke her language.
sentences.zh: 她觉得他确实关心像她这样的人，并且说着与她相同的语言。

sentences.en: So she got really excited and thought that maybe they would have a chance, that he would swoop in and save them.
sentences.zh: 所以她变得非常激动，以为他们也许还有机会，以为他会从天而降拯救他们。

sentences.en: I assume this isn't all for me.
sentences.zh: 我想这不全是给我的吧。

sentences.en: First of all, welcome to Carrier Indianapolis.
sentences.zh: 首先，欢迎来到印第安纳州开利公司。

sentences.en: It's an honor to welcome President-elect Trump as well as Vice President-elect Pence and the new governor, Governor Holcomb from Indiana today.
sentences.zh: 今天非常荣幸能欢迎当选总统特朗普，以及当选副总统彭斯和印第安纳州新任州长霍尔科姆阁下。

sentences.en: A couple of weeks after Trump wins, he comes to Indianapolis and announces this deal to save some jobs at a plant called Carrier.
sentences.zh: 在特朗普胜选几周后，他来到印第安纳州，并宣布了一项旨在拯救一家名为开利工厂的部分工作岗位的协议。

sentences.en: And in fact, it's the same union.
sentences.zh: 事实上，那是同一个工会。

sentences.en: And the president-elect of the United States of America, Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 美利坚合众国当选总统，唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: So the people at the Rex Nord plant get their hopes up even more.
sentences.zh: 因此，雷克诺德工厂的人们燃起了更高的希望。

sentences.en: And you can see on their Facebook pages, a lot of them are like, he gets results.
sentences.zh: 你可以从他们的脸书主页上看到，许多人都在说，他能搞定结果。

sentences.en: It's going to happen.
sentences.zh: 这事儿稳了。

sentences.en: You have to understand, we can't allow this to happen anymore with our country.
sentences.zh: 你们必须明白，我们再也不能允许这种事情在我们的国家发生了。

sentences.en: So many jobs are leaving and going to other countries, not just Mexico, many, many countries.
sentences.zh: 如此多的工作岗位正在流失并转移到其他国家，不仅仅是墨西哥，还有许许多多的国家。

sentences.en: But we're losing companies.
sentences.zh: 但我们正在失去公司。

sentences.en: It's unbelievable.
sentences.zh: 这简直难以置信。

sentences.en: One after another.
sentences.zh: 一家接一家。

sentences.en: Just one after another.
sentences.zh: 简直是一家接一家。

sentences.en: We're going to have a lot of phone calls made to companies when they say they're thinking about leaving this country because they're not leaving this country.
sentences.zh: 当公司声称考虑离开这个国家时，我们要给它们打很多电话，因为它们绝不会离开这个国家。

sentences.en: They're not going to leave this country.
sentences.zh: 它们不会离开这个国家。

sentences.en: And the workers are going to keep their jobs and they can leave from state to state and they can negotiate good deals with the different states and all of that.
sentences.zh: 工人们将保住他们的工作，公司可以在各州之间搬迁，并与不同的州谈判达成好的协议，诸如此类。

sentences.en: But leaving the country is going to be very, very difficult.
sentences.zh: 但是离开这个国家将会变得非常、非常困难。

sentences.en: So they get even more excited.
sentences.zh: 所以他们变得更加兴奋了。

sentences.en: But the company keeps pressing forward with its plans.
sentences.zh: 但公司仍在继续推进其计划。

sentences.en: And you see a letter from the CEO hanging on the bulletin board saying, nope, we're moving.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到布告栏上挂着一封首席执行官的信，上面写着，不，我们要搬走。

sentences.en: And we're going to bring Mexican trainees into the plant in the next few weeks.
sentences.zh: 我们将在接下来的几周内把墨西哥的实习生带到工厂来。

sentences.zh: 我们希望你们培训你们的接替者。

sentences.zh: 如果你不这样做，你就拿不到遣散费。

sentences.zh: 因此，工厂车间的每一个工人都面临着这样一个决定：我是去培训我的接替者，还是拒绝？

sentences.zh: 决定培训接替者的人和那些站出来说不的人之间，产生了巨大的分裂。

sentences.en: To see what's going on across this entire country is disgusting.
sentences.zh: 看到整个国家正在发生的事情，真让人作呕。

sentences.en: It's disgusting.

sentences.zh: 他们必须依靠我们来培训。

sentences.zh: 只有我的同事们掌握这些知识。

sentences.en: Just to be honest with you.
sentences.zh: 说实话。

sentences.en: It's no different if we were out on strike and you crossed the picket line in my eyes.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，这跟我们罢工而你越过纠察线没有任何区别。

sentences.en: It was a very divisive time.
sentences.zh: 那是一个矛盾重重的时期。

sentences.en: Friendships ended.
sentences.zh: 友谊破裂了。

sentences.en: People stopped speaking to each other.
sentences.zh: 人们不再和彼此说话。

sentences.en: I didn't want to go verbally attack.
sentences.zh: 我不想去口头上攻击。

sentences.en: Emotions were high.
sentences.zh: 当时情绪非常激动。

sentences.en: I didn't want to go verbally just attack him and assault him.
sentences.zh: 我不想去口头上攻击他、辱骂他。

sentences.en: So I let a couple of days go by and I just basically said, man, I can't believe you're going to do that.
sentences.zh: 所以我让几天时间过去，基本上就对他说，伙计，我真不敢相信你要这么做。

sentences.en: You know, you're selling us all out.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你把我们全出卖了。

sentences.en: One guy walked out of the factory and quit when he heard that his friend had signed up to train.
sentences.zh: 有个伙计一听说他的朋友报名参加培训，就气冲冲地走出了工厂并辞职了。

sentences.en: He just walked out and ended his own career there.
sentences.zh: 他就这么走了，在那里结束了自己的职业生涯。

sentences.en: Walked away from your severance, walked away from everything and quit.
sentences.zh: 放弃了你的遣散费，放弃了一切，然后辞职了。

sentences.en: He left like more than $10,000 in severance.
sentences.zh: 他留下了超过一万美元的遣散费。

sentences.en: And I later talked to him and he said, yeah, it's just depressing to see that you ain't got a future.
sentences.zh: 我后来跟他聊过，他说，是的，看到你毫无前途真是让人沮丧。

sentences.en: You know, we talk a lot in this country about the white working class, the working class.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们在这个国家经常谈论白人工人阶级、工人阶级。

sentences.en: We talk about it like it's white.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论它的时候，好像它是白人专属的一样。

sentences.en: But in fact, the working class is not white.
sentences.zh: 但事实上，工人阶级并不全是白人。

sentences.en: There's a lot of black people in the working class.
sentences.zh: 工人阶级中有很大一部分是黑人。

sentences.en: And this factory was about 40 percent black.
sentences.zh: 而这家工厂大约有百分之四十是黑人。

sentences.en: And from what I could tell, people really got along.
sentences.zh: 据我所能看到的，大家相处得真的很好。

sentences.en: They were on the bowling team together.
sentences.zh: 他们一起加入保龄球队。

sentences.en: They went to Colts games together.
sentences.zh: 他们一起去看小马队的比赛。

sentences.en: They ate dinner at each other's houses.
sentences.zh: 他们在彼此家里吃晚饭。

sentences.en: There were at least two romances that I knew of that were interracial.
sentences.zh: 据我所知，至少有两段跨种族恋情。

sentences.en: It was a very interracial factory.
sentences.zh: 那是一家极具多元种族特色的工厂。

sentences.en: But I noticed a pattern.
sentences.zh: 但我注意到了一种模式。

sentences.en: A lot of the people who were so upset about the closing, the people who walked out without their severance,
sentences.zh: 许多对工厂关闭感到极其沮丧的人，那些没有拿遣散费就离开的人，

sentences.en: or the people who went on television and talked about how they felt like nothing.
sentences.zh: 或者那些上电视讲述自己觉得自己一文不值的人。

sentences.en: They were so outraged by this.
sentences.zh: 他们对此感到无比愤怒。

sentences.en: They were white.
sentences.zh: 他们都是白人。

sentences.en: And when you talk to the black workers, so many of them made the decision to train right away from the beginning and with no shame.
sentences.zh: 而当你跟黑人工人交谈时，他们当中有很多人从一开始就毫不羞愧地做出了去培训的决定。

sentences.en: They just raised their hands.
sentences.zh: 他们只是举起了手。

sentences.en: They said, I'm going to get that money.
sentences.zh: 他们说，我要拿到那笔钱。

sentences.en: We can't change this decision.
sentences.zh: 我们改变不了这个决定。

sentences.en: We can't stop it.
sentences.zh: 我们阻止不了它。

sentences.en: Let's just agree to train and get that money.
sentences.zh: 我们不如就同意去培训，把那笔钱拿到手。

sentences.en: Farrah, how do you account for the grievances of the white worker and their unwillingness to train the Mexican workers
sentences.zh: 法拉，你如何解释白人工人的不满以及他们不愿培训墨西哥工人的情绪，

sentences.en: versus the general willingness of the black workers in the factory to participate in that?
sentences.zh: 相比之下，为什么工厂里的黑人工人普遍愿意参与其中？

sentences.en: You can see a lot of studies, nationwide studies, about the American dream and optimism.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到很多关于美国梦和乐观主义的研究，全国性的研究。

sentences.en: And you'll find that working class whites are very pessimistic about the future.
sentences.zh: 你会发现，工人阶级的白人对未来非常悲观。

sentences.en: They don't believe the future is going to be better than the past because they've seen their economic prospects decline for 30 years.
sentences.zh: 他们不相信未来会比过去更好，因为他们眼睁睁看着自己的经济前景三十年来一直在走下坡路。

sentences.en: You know, in the 60s, that factory was probably all white men.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，在六十年代，那家工厂可能全都是白人男性。

sentences.en: And in order to get a job there, you had to pretty much know someone in there.
sentences.zh: 而且要想在那里找到一份工作，你基本上得认识里面的人。

sentences.en: So they had like a monopoly on all those jobs.
sentences.zh: 所以他们对所有这些工作有着某种垄断地位。

sentences.en: And then over time, you see their monopoly on the job disappears.
sentences.zh: 然后随着时间的推移，你会发现他们对工作的垄断消失了。

sentences.en: There's no denying that the economic prospects of a white guy without a college degree has declined pretty dramatically over the last three years.
sentences.zh: 不可否认的是，没有大学文凭的白人男性的经济前景在过去三年里急剧下降。

sentences.en: Whereas everybody else have still seen an upward climb because they started from such a low place.
sentences.zh: 而其他所有人仍在经历着向上的攀升，因为他们的起点实在是太低了。

sentences.en: And so I think when you talk to black workers, one, they didn't feel entitled to the job.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得，当你跟黑人工人交谈时，第一，他们不觉得这份工作是他们应得的。

sentences.en: And two, they thought, well, we're used to it.
sentences.zh: 第二，他们想，好吧，我们已经习惯了。

sentences.en: We're used to bad things happening to us.
sentences.zh: 我们习惯了坏事降临在我们头上。

sentences.en: And three, I think they still feel like the best days are ahead.
sentences.zh: 第三，我觉得他们依然觉得最美好的日子还在后头。

sentences.en: What about the women in the factory?
sentences.zh: 工厂里的女性呢？

sentences.en: I mean, I think the women were also more willing to volunteer to train.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我觉得女性也更愿意自愿去参加培训。

sentences.en: Maybe they needed the money more or maybe they remembered what it was like when people didn't want to train them.
sentences.zh: 也许她们更需要钱，或者也许她们还记得当年别人不想培训她们时的情景。

sentences.en: I stopped and I thought about it, you know.
sentences.zh: 我停下来想了想，你知道的。

sentences.en: Shannon's granddaughter had spent months in a coma that year.
sentences.zh: 香农的孙女那一年在昏迷中度过了好几个月。

sentences.en: She had lost all her fingers.
sentences.zh: 她失去了所有的手指。

sentences.en: Somehow the cannula punctured through her heart.
sentences.zh: 不知怎么的，导管刺穿了她的心脏。

sentences.en: So she had went into cardiac arreSt.
sentences.zh: 所以她心搏骤停了。

sentences.en: She has a scar on her cheSt.
sentences.zh: 她的胸口有一道伤疤。

sentences.en: I took my eyeliner and I traced the scar around her chest and it looks just like an angel wings.
sentences.zh: 我用眼线笔沿着她胸口的伤疤描画，它看起来就像天使的翅膀一样。

sentences.en: Right on the front because she had like four open heart surgeries that week.
sentences.zh: 就在正面，因为她那一周大概做了四次心脏直视手术。

sentences.en: She doesn't walk anymore.
sentences.zh: 她再也不能走路了。

sentences.en: She don't talk anymore.
sentences.zh: 她再也不会说话了。

sentences.en: She has a trach.
sentences.zh: 她做了气管切开手术。

sentences.en: She lost all of her fingers on her right hand.
sentences.zh: 她失去了右手所有的手指。

sentences.en: And she lost all the tips of her finger on her.
sentences.zh: 而且她失去了她所有手指的指尖。

sentences.en: But I'll tell you what, she's a fighter because she's still here and she's a happy little baby.
sentences.zh: 但我告诉你，她是个坚强的斗士，因为她依然留在这里，而且她是一个快乐的小宝贝。

sentences.en: She goes through a lot.
sentences.zh: 她经历了很多。

sentences.en: I always think, you know, things could be worse.
sentences.zh: 我总是想，你知道的，情况可能会更糟。

sentences.en: What is your granddaughter's name?
sentences.zh: 你孙女叫什么名字？

sentences.en: Carmela.
sentences.zh: 卡梅拉。

sentences.en: Carmela Linda Marie Roberts.
sentences.zh: 卡梅拉·琳达·玛丽·罗伯茨。
zh_words: 卡梅拉·琳达·玛丽·罗伯茨

sentences.en: So Shannon really has a lot on her shoulders this year.
sentences.zh: 所以香农今年真的压力很大。

sentences.en: And she really thought, well, I need this money.
sentences.zh: 她真的在想，好吧，我需要这笔钱。

sentences.en: I need this money to take care of my family.
sentences.zh: 我需要这笔钱来照顾我的家人。

sentences.en: And I'm going to take every dime I can get.
sentences.zh: 我要拿走我能弄到的每一分钱。

sentences.en: And that's what's important here.
sentences.zh: 这才是这里重要的事情。

sentences.en: That's what the main goal is here.
sentences.zh: 这才是这里的主要目标。

sentences.en: It's all about that dollar bill, that mighty dollar bill.
sentences.zh: 一切为了那一美元，那万能的一美元。

sentences.en: And you know what?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.en: I'm going to make it while I can make it because I'll never have a chance again to probably make that again.
sentences.zh: 趁我还能赚的时候我要把它赚到手，因为我可能再也没有机会赚到那么多了。

sentences.en: So ultimately, she decided to do the training.
sentences.zh: 所以最终，她决定参加培训。

sentences.en: So when did the Mexican workers first arrive?
sentences.zh: 那么墨西哥工是什么时候第一批到达的？

sentences.en: So right around Christmastime, the first group comes.
sentences.zh: 就在圣诞节前后，第一批人来了。

sentences.en: And when they walk in the plant, some people freeze.
sentences.zh: 当他们走进车间时，有些人当场愣住了。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: We just looked at them, you know.
sentences.zh: 我们只是看着他们，你知道的。

sentences.en: Everybody would be like, you know, the Mexican workers are here.
sentences.zh: 每个人都会说，你知道的，墨西哥工人来了。

sentences.en: You'd see them walk by in a group and stuff like that.
sentences.zh: 你会看到他们成群结队地走过之类的情景。

sentences.en: And how did Shannon approach the Mexican workers?
sentences.zh: 香农是如何对待墨西哥工人的？

sentences.en: Did she resent them?
sentences.zh: 她对他们心怀怨恨吗？

sentences.en: Did she embrace them?
sentences.zh: 她接纳了他们吗？

sentences.en: I think once they came, she really pretty quickly formed a bond with them.
sentences.zh: 我觉得一旦他们来了，她很快就和他们建立起了纽带。

sentences.en: She took one young Mexican trainee under her wing and really decided to train him the way that she'd been trained, pretty much.
sentences.zh: 她把一个年轻的墨西哥学员护在羽翼之下，并基本上决定按照她自己受训的方式来培训他。

sentences.en: I think I mother-hinned him kind of like he was just like, he's my son's age.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我有点像老母鸡护雏一样照顾他，他就跟，他跟我儿子一般大。

sentences.en: He's a good kid.
sentences.zh: 他是个好孩子。

sentences.en: You know, she could have just done the minimum.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，她本可以只做到最低限度。

sentences.en: She could have just answered a few questions.
sentences.zh: 她本可以只回答几个问题就行了。

sentences.en: But she wanted him to know the job.
sentences.zh: 但她想让他真正掌握这项工作。

sentences.en: And she trained him the way that she was trained.
sentences.zh: 她按照自己受训的方式去培训他。

sentences.en: So she's passing on this knowledge.
sentences.zh: 所以她在传递这份知识。

sentences.en: And that knowledge is really all these workers have, right?
sentences.zh: 而这份知识真的是这些工人仅有的全部，对吧？

sentences.en: It's what makes them valuable as people in their minds and, I guess, in the factory itself.
sentences.zh: 在他们心中，以及我想在工厂本身，正是这些让他们作为人体现出价值。

sentences.en: Tad.
sentences.zh: 塔德。

sentences.en: I call him Tad because I never could really say his name right.
sentences.zh: 我叫他塔德，因为我从来没能真正把他的名字念对。

sentences.en: After I trained him, he'd go to lunch and he would come back and he brought me a cookie from his lunch.
sentences.zh: 在我培训完他之后，他去吃午饭，回来时从他的午饭里给我带了一块曲奇饼。

sentences.en: You know, and he says, my friend tells me that, you know, a lot of your people here doesn't like us.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他说，我的朋友告诉我说，你知道的，你们这里的很多人不喜欢我们。

sentences.en: He says, I didn't know that I'm taking your job.
sentences.zh: 他说，我不知道我是在抢你的工作。

sentences.en: I am so sorry that I, and I said, no.
sentences.zh: 我很抱歉我，我说，不。

sentences.en: I said, don't be sorry.
sentences.zh: 我说，别说抱歉。

sentences.en: I said, it's corporate greed.
sentences.zh: 我说，这是公司的贪婪。

sentences.en: I said, just, I'm glad that you were able to have that opportunity like I was able to have that opportunity.
sentences.zh: 我说，只是，我很高兴你能有机会，就像我能有机会一样。

sentences.en: I could tell from the heart he was very sincere about how he felt bad.
sentences.zh: 我能看出他发自内心地为自己感到不好而感到非常真诚。

sentences.en: That he did not know.
sentences.zh: 他并不知道。

sentences.en: No one told them.
sentences.zh: 没有人告诉过他们。

sentences.en: No one told them.
sentences.zh: 没有人告诉过他们。

sentences.en: And so Shannon tried to be super nice and super upbeat with them.
sentences.zh: 所以香农努力对他们超级好、超级乐观。

sentences.en: But she would never leave them alone in the factory.
sentences.zh: 但她绝不会让他们独自留在工厂里。

sentences.en: She took them everywhere she went.
sentences.zh: 她去哪儿都带着他们。

sentences.en: Because she feared something might happen to them?
sentences.zh: 因为她担心他们可能会出事？

sentences.en: I mean, she didn't say it in so many words, but she didn't want anything to happen to them.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，她没有明说，但她不希望他们出任何事。

sentences.en: So she protected them?
sentences.zh: 所以她在保护他们？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Did she say why she did that?
sentences.zh: 她说过她为什么这么做吗？

sentences.en: I mean, I think all of the trainers ended up really seeing their trainees as human beings and seeing themselves in this other person.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我觉得所有的培训师到头来都真正把他们的学员当成了人，并在另一个人身上看到了自己。

sentences.en: Very respectful, very nice.
sentences.zh: 非常尊敬，非常好。

sentences.en: Very much so like me, you know.
sentences.zh: 非常像我，你知道的。

sentences.en: So what happens in the summer, Farrah?
sentences.zh: 那么夏天发生了什么，法拉？

sentences.en: So in August, the last time I went to Indianapolis was the sort of the culmination of all of this.
sentences.zh: 所以在八月，我最后一次去印第安纳波利斯，那是所有这一切的某种高潮。

sentences.en: Her daughter goes off to college.
sentences.zh: 她的女儿去上大学了。

sentences.en: She drops her daughter off at college.
sentences.zh: 她把女儿送到大学去。

sentences.en: And then the next day she goes into the factory and they're disconnecting her favorite machine, the taco.
sentences.zh: 然后第二天她走进工厂，他们正在拆卸她最喜欢的机器——塔可机。

sentences.en: One of the Mexican team is there and they're taking it away from her.
sentences.zh: 其中一个墨西哥团队的成员就在那里，他们正在把机器从她身边夺走。

sentences.en: And I had to turn around and walk outside so that everybody didn't see me crying.
sentences.zh: 我不得不转过身走到外面，这样大家就不会看到我在哭。

sentences.en: And it was upsetting.
sentences.zh: 这让人心烦意乱。

sentences.en: Very.
sentences.zh: 非常心烦。

sentences.en: So, because I was feeling like everything, even now.
sentences.zh: 所以，因为我觉得一切，即使到现在。

sentences.en: It's very upsetting.
sentences.zh: 这真的很让人难过。

sentences.en: Because it's like, everything is gone.
sentences.zh: 因为这就好像，一切都消失了。

sentences.en: And there's nothing I can do about it.
sentences.zh: 而我对此外毫无办法。

sentences.en: Just get up and keep going.
sentences.zh: 只能振作起来继续前行。

sentences.en: Hold on, Carrie.
sentences.zh: 等等，凯莉。

sentences.en: Ready?
sentences.zh: 准备好了吗？

sentences.en: It seemed like a pretty poignant moment.
sentences.zh: 那似乎是一个挺揪心的时刻。

sentences.en: I believe it was actually caught on video of where you were in this kind of empty factory.
sentences.zh: 我记得当时确实拍下了视频，你在那种空荡荡的工厂里。

sentences.en: What was, at this point, what does it look like inside the factory?
sentences.zh: 当时工厂里面是什么样子的？

sentences.en: How many machines are left?
sentences.zh: 还剩多少机器？

sentences.en: What is it starting to look like?
sentences.zh: 现在开始变成什么样了？

sentences.en: It looks like a ghost factory.
sentences.zh: 看起来就像一座鬼厂。

sentences.en: The factory was so empty that I was able to ride our bicycle, off-trail, shall I say, ride all around the factory on the bicycle because there was nothing left.
sentences.zh: 工厂空得我甚至可以骑着自行车，可以说是脱离小路，在工厂里到处骑车，因为里面什么都不剩了。

sentences.en: That's how it looks.
sentences.zh: 情况就是这样。

sentences.en: There's nothing left.
sentences.zh: 什么都不剩了。

sentences.en: At what point did it dawn on you that the president, that nobody, but especially that the president, couldn't do anything about this or wouldn't or to save the jobs?
sentences.zh: 你是什么时候突然意识到，总统，或者说没有人——尤其是总统——对此无能为力，或者根本不打算做点什么来挽救这些工作岗位的？

sentences.en: I don't know if he just couldn't or he just wouldn't.
sentences.zh: 我不知道他是真的做不到，还是根本不想做。

sentences.en: I felt kind of let down, shall I say, you know.
sentences.zh: 怎么说呢，我感觉有点被抛弃了。

sentences.en: I think he just said that just because of his campaign.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他那样说只是为了竞选。

sentences.en: Then after he's got in there, then he done forgot about us.
sentences.zh: 然后等他上台之后，就把我们忘得精光。

sentences.en: We don't, it don't matter anymore.
sentences.zh: 我们，这已经无所谓了。

sentences.en: You know, oh, he's going to raise the tariff and all this other stuff.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，哦，他要提高关税这类的。

sentences.en: Well, why don't you, why wouldn't you have done it or try to tell them?
sentences.zh: 那好吧，你为什么不早点做，或者试着跟他们说呢？

sentences.en: I don't know what they do, but, you know, he's got other things to tend to.
sentences.zh: 我不知道他们在搞什么名堂，不过，你知道的，他还有别的事要忙。

sentences.en: We're not, I don't think that we're part of his agenda anymore.
sentences.zh: 我们已经，我觉得我们不再在他的议程之列了。

sentences.en: That's obvious.
sentences.zh: 显而易见。

sentences.en: Shannon's last day was two weeks ago.
sentences.zh: 香农的最后一天是两周前。

sentences.en: I have to keep my keys in.
sentences.zh: 我得把钥匙留着。

sentences.en: Take care.
sentences.zh: 多保重。

sentences.en: When it come to doing my last, loading the furnace for the last time, it didn't hit me till then.
sentences.zh: 轮到我最后一次操作，最后一次给炉子装料的时候，直到那一刻我才真正缓过神来。

sentences.en: Things are just totally different.
sentences.zh: 一切都完全变了。

sentences.en: I'm trying to get adjusted.
sentences.zh: 我正在努力适应。

sentences.en: And not feel so worthless.
sentences.zh: 并且不要觉得自己那么一文不值。

sentences.en: I know I'm not worthless, but I feel worthless.
sentences.zh: 我知道自己并非一文不值，但我就是觉得自己很没用。

sentences.en: Why do you feel worthless?
sentences.zh: 你为什么觉得自己没用？

sentences.en: Because I feel like, I don't feel as good about it as feeling secure to be able to support my family.
sentences.zh: 因为我觉得，这种感觉远不如能够安稳地养家糊口那样踏实。

sentences.en: That's why.
sentences.zh: 这就是原因。

sentences.en: How they can just up and rip it away from you is just wrong.
sentences.zh: 他们怎么能说夺走就夺走，这太不对了。

sentences.en: I mean, I could see, like I said, if we wasn't making any money or we was doing such a poor job.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，就像我说的，如果我们没有赚钱或者表现得很糟，我还能理解。

sentences.en: Bottom line is when you're doing a good job and even tell you you're doing a good job and they turn around and just throw you to the side like you're nothing.
sentences.zh: 最根本的是，当你干得很好，甚至别人也夸你干得很好时，他们一转头却把你像废品一样扔到一边。

sentences.en: And it's very hard to take and swallow, you know, you know, you know, you know, and it's like, I'm not that marketable out there.
sentences.zh: 这真的很难接受和消化，你知道，你知道，你知道，而且感觉我在外面已经没什么市场了。

sentences.en: Who's going to want an old woman now?
sentences.zh: 现在谁会想要一个老太婆呢？

sentences.en: You know, I think it's just been a roller coaster.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我觉得这就像坐过山车一样。

sentences.en: After seven months and I think now that it's over, she's finally got to sit down and look at her life and decide what she does next.
sentences.zh: 七个月过去了，我想现在这一切终于结束了，她也终于可以坐下来审视自己的生活，决定下一步该怎么走。

sentences.en: Who does she become now that she's no longer the heat treat operator at the sparing factory?
sentences.zh: 既然她不再是斯佩林工厂的热处理操作工，那她现在成了谁？

sentences.en: I lived and I breathed my job.
sentences.zh: 我的生活和呼吸都维系在工作上。

sentences.en: I was in there a lot of times, seven days a week for a lot of years.
sentences.zh: 很多时候，我多年来都是一周七天泡在里面。

sentences.en: And I am grateful that my uncle got me that job.
sentences.zh: 我很感激我叔叔帮我找到了那份工作。

sentences.en: I am grateful and thankful that I was able to have that job because a lot of people don't look out that way because I didn't have a college degree.
sentences.zh: 我很感激也很庆幸自己能拥有那份工作，因为很多人没有这种运气，而且我没有大学文凭。

sentences.en: But, you know, I made as much money probably as some of the college degree people did, you know.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，我赚的钱大概和一些有大学文凭的人差不多，你知道的。

sentences.en: And, you know, because we get interns that come in over there and they wouldn't know anything.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，因为我们那边经常来一些实习生，他们什么都不懂。

sentences.en: But they have a lot of years of college.
sentences.zh: 但他们读了很多年大学。

sentences.en: But so that's where I guess they knew more than me, but not really when it comes to running the parts.
sentences.zh: 所以我想这就是他们比我懂得多地方，但在实际操作零件这方面，其实并不是。

sentences.en: The Rexnerd factory was originally slated to close in April, but that was delayed until September because the new plants were taking longer than expected to get up to speed.
sentences.zh: 雷克斯纳德工厂原本计划在四月份关闭，但由于新工厂投产的速度比预期慢，关闭时间推迟到了九月份。

sentences.en: Shannon's daughter, Nicole, just started as a freshman at Purdue University, where she's planning to study nursing.
sentences.zh: 香农的女儿妮可刚刚成为普渡大学的一名大一新生，她计划在那里学习护理专业。

sentences.en: She was awarded more than $30,000 in scholarships to cover her tuition.
sentences.zh: 她获得了超过3万美元的奖学金来支付学费。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: For the third time, a federal judge has blocked President Trump from enacting a ban on foreign travelers just hours before it was set to take effect.
sentences.zh: 就在联邦法院原定实施针对外国旅客禁令的几个小时前，第三次叫停了特朗普总统颁布的这项禁令。

sentences.en: The latest ban, which would have barred citizens of seven countries from entering the U.S.,
sentences.zh: 最新禁令原本将禁止七国公民入境美国，

sentences.en: was designed to avoid the claims of discrimination that have undermined Trump's last two bans.
sentences.zh: 其目的是为了避免引发之前两次导致特朗普禁令失效的歧视指控。

sentences.en: But Judge Derek Watson of Hawaii found that the ban was discriminatory by barring entire nationalities without proving that they pose a threat to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但夏威夷州的联邦地区法官德里克·沃森认为，该禁令在没有证明相关国籍人员对美国构成威胁的情况下，对整个国家的人员实施禁令，构成了歧视。

sentences.en: Later this week, Senator Murray and I, with other senators,
sentences.zh: 本周晚些时候，默里参议员和我，以及其他参议员，

sentences.en: will introduce bipartisan legislation to give states additional flexibility to create more choices of health insurance policies in the individual market.
sentences.zh: 将提出一项两党立法，赋予各州更大的灵活性，以便在个人市场上提供更多医疗保险政策的选择。

sentences.en: Days after the president said he would cut off the payments that have made insurance cheaper for the poor under the Affordable Care Act, two leading senators,
sentences.zh: 就在总统表示将切断根据《平价医疗法案》让穷人享受更便宜保险的补贴几天后，两位重量级参议员——

sentences.en: Republican Lamar Alexander and Democrat Patty Murray, say they've reached a deal that would fund those payments for the next two years.
sentences.zh: 共和党人拉马尔·亚历山大和民主党人帕蒂·默里——表示他们已经达成一项协议，将在未来两年内继续为这些补贴提供资金。

sentences.en: Our goal is to stabilize and then lower the cost of premiums and to enable all Americans to have access to health insurance.
sentences.zh: 我们的目标是稳定并随后降低保费成本，让所有美国人都能买得起医疗保险。

sentences.en: Without the payments, the Times reports, insurance premiums for low-income Americans are expected to soar next year.
sentences.zh: 据《泰晤士报》报道，如果没有这些补贴，低收入美国人的医疗保险保费预计明年将大幅飙升。

sentences.en: And many companies may stop offering insurance under the ACA.
sentences.zh: 许多公司也可能会停止根据《平价医疗法案》提供保险。

sentences.en: So we concluded that the best course would be to take this limited, bipartisan first step that would avoid the chaos that could occur during 2018 and 2019.
sentences.zh: 因此我们得出结论，最好的做法是采取这一有限的、两党合作的第一步，从而避免2018至2019年期间可能出现的混乱。

sentences.en: President Trump said he is open to supporting the deal.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统表示，他持开放态度支持这项协议。

sentences.en: But it is a short-term solution so that we don't have this very dangerous little period.
sentences.zh: 但这只是一个短期解决方案，这样我们就不会经历这段非常危险的过渡期。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是今天的《每日简报》。

sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴伯。

sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器在运作。

sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。
